name: BackRoad
definition: BackRoad is BlackRoad's social layer. BackRoad has two views: 1) The all-social feed view: A unified feed that can bring together the user's social media from external platforms and BackRoad itself. 2) The native BackRoad social view: BlackRoad's own creator/community social app. BackRoad exists because modern social platforms became algorithmic, ad-heavy, manipulative, and creator-hostile. BackRoad should help users and creators regain ownership, context, and sanity. BackRoad should support social feed aggregation, native BackRoad posts, creator/community profiles, comments and replies, creator ownership, and social graph portability.
core_promise: See the social world without being owned by it.
